name: OmaGuake
author: Bram van Oploo
description: Guake/Yakuake-style drop-down terminal with tabs, gesture controls, and conflict-checked configuration for Omarchy

barWidget.description: Guake-style drop-down terminal with tabs and trackpad gestures

schema.label: Height percentage
schema.description: Height of the drop-down terminal overlay (20-100%).

schema.label: Width percentage
schema.description: Width of the drop-down terminal overlay (20-100%, default 100%).

schema.label: Terminal opacity percentage
schema.description: Opacity percentage of the terminal background (20-100%).

schema.label: Scroll speed
schema.description: Terminal scroll speed step 1 (minimum / smooth) to 5 (maximum / tmux default).

schema.label: Tabs position
schema.description: Position of the tabs bar ('bottom' for Guake style, 'top' for Yakuake style).

schema.label: Toggle keybinding
schema.description: Global shortcut chord to summon and hide the dropdown terminal.

schema.label: Auto-hide on focus loss
schema.description: Automatically slide up and hide when focus is lost.
